seoTitle: VDS Dealer & Integrator Program | Wholesale Pricing
metaDescription: VDS dealer program — wholesale pricing on trailers and platform, MAP enforcement, dealer portal, marketing co-op. Tiered by annual volume.
h1: Dealer Pricing for Integrators Who Sell Mobile Surveillance
heroSubhead: Wholesale margins on trailers and platform, MAP-enforced retail pricing, marketing development funds, and a portal that doesn't require a phone call to use.
body:
## Who this is for

The VDS dealer program is built for security integrators, low-voltage contractors, and managed service providers who already sell to commercial end customers and want to add mobile surveillance and a hosted VMS to the offering. It's not a referral program — dealers transact, fulfill, and own the customer relationship.

If you're looking to refer leads to VDS for a commission, that's our separate referral program. Ask sales.

## Volume tiers

Dealer pricing is structured around trailing-12-month volume. Tiers reset every January 1; new dealers start at Tier 1 and move up based on actual closed volume.

| Tier | Annual Volume | Trailer Discount | Platform Discount | MDF |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Tier 1 — Authorized** | $0-$100K | 12% off list | 10% off list | — |
| **Tier 2 — Preferred** | $100K-$500K | 18% off list | 15% off list | 1% of revenue |
| **Tier 3 — Premier** | $500K-$2M | 25% off list | 20% off list | 2% of revenue |
| **Tier 4 — Strategic** | $2M+ | Negotiated | Negotiated | 3% of revenue |

Discounts apply to the published list prices on [the main pricing page](/pricing). MDF (Marketing Development Funds) accrues quarterly, paid as co-op against approved marketing spend or as bill credits.

## MAP policy

Minimum Advertised Price is published with the program and enforced. Dealers may discount in private quotes — that's normal commercial behavior — but advertised pricing (website, public ads, public proposals) must hold the line at MAP or above. The reason is structural: published prices on the VDS main pricing page are the floor. Dealers undercutting public pricing in public is what creates the race-to-the-bottom dynamic that destroys margin for everyone.

MAP violations get a written warning on the first incident. Two violations in a 12-month window suspends program eligibility for 90 days. Three suspends indefinitely.

## What dealers get

**Wholesale pricing.** Per the tier table above, applied to any line item on a customer order — trailers, platform subscriptions, SOC monitoring, accessories.

**Dealer portal.** Quote builder, order entry, deal registration, marketing assets, training, and commission/MDF tracking. The portal is self-serve. Most orders never require a sales call.

**Deal registration.** Register a deal with VDS and lock pricing for 90 days, protecting you from another dealer or direct sale undercutting your work-in-flight. Approved registrations get a 5% additional discount on top of tier pricing.

**Technical training and certification.** Free online certification path for sales and field tech roles. Certified Field Tech is the prerequisite for billing customer-facing installs through the dealer channel.

**Marketing assets.** Co-branded brochures, web pages, slide decks, case studies. Customizable with your logo and contact info.

**Marketing Development Funds.** Quarterly accrual at the tier rate, redeemable against approved campaigns (trade shows, paid ads, content production) or as account credit.

**Demo trailer program.** Dealers at Tier 2+ can request a loaner trailer for customer demos. Loan period is 14 days. One loan per quarter at Tier 2, unlimited at Tier 3+.

## What dealers commit to

- Sell only the trailers and platform tiers listed on the current VDS lineup
- Honor MAP on all public pricing and advertising
- Complete the Authorized certification within 90 days of program entry
- Maintain commercial general liability and E&O insurance with VDS named as additional insured
- Use deal registration for any opportunity over $25K
- Submit a forecast and pipeline review quarterly (15-minute call, sales team driven)

## Co-marketing and lead-share

VDS routes inbound leads to dealers based on geography, vertical specialty, and tier. Tier 3 and Tier 4 dealers get first right of refusal on inbound leads in their territory. Tier 1 and Tier 2 dealers get leads on a round-robin basis after Tier 3/4 declines.

Outbound demand-gen co-investment (paid media, trade shows, event sponsorships) is available to Tier 2+ dealers via MDF and proposal-based campaign funding.

## How to apply

The dealer application is short. We're looking for:

- An active business with a security or low-voltage integration history
- General liability insurance ($1M minimum, $2M preferred)
- A named technical contact and a named sales contact
- Brief overview of your geographic and vertical focus

Most applications are approved within 5 business days. We'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff to walk through the portal, deal registration, and certification before your first quote goes out.

faq.q: Can I sell into any geography?
faq.a: Yes, but lead routing favors dealers with a documented presence in the region. There's no exclusive territory in the program at any tier.

faq.q: What if my customer wants direct VDS support?
faq.a: Standard platform support is direct from VDS regardless of who sold the deployment. Implementation, on-site service, and account management can stay with you or transition to VDS direct — customer's choice.

faq.q: Do I have to white-label the platform?
faq.a: No. The platform is VDS-branded. Dealer co-branding is available on customer-facing portals at Tier 3+ if the dealer specifically wants it.

faq.q: Can I bundle VDS with other products?
faq.a: Yes, as long as the VDS components meet MAP. Most dealers bundle trailers with access control, alarm panels, or fence detection from other manufacturers — that's normal.

faq.q: What happens if I drop volume tier?
faq.a: Tiers are based on trailing 12 months and recalculated quarterly. If you drop a tier, you keep the higher tier's pricing on existing in-flight quotes (registered deals), but new quotes price at the new tier. We don't retroactively re-bill.

finalCTABody: Apply, get certified, start quoting. Most dealers issue their first VDS quote within 30 days of application approval.
notes: Channel program page — guard against giving away specifics that would compromise direct-sale pricing. MAP language is intentional.

metaDescription: VDS trailer leasing terms — 3-month minimum, month-to-month after, includes platform, SOC optional. Short-term event rentals and multi-year fleet leases.
h1: Lease a Trailer Without Surprise Charges
heroSubhead: Standard 3-month minimum, month-to-month after. Hardware, platform, freight on a quote, and a 7-business-day standard lead time. Long-term and short-term options below.
body:
## Standard lease terms

VDS trailer leases are designed to be readable in five minutes. The terms below apply to every lease unless you negotiate an enterprise master agreement.

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| **Minimum term** | 3 months |
| **After minimum** | Month-to-month, 30-day notice to cancel |
| **Security deposit** | One month's lease, refundable |
| **Lead time (standard)** | 5-10 business days |
| **Lead time (expedited)** | 48-72 hours, premium applies |
| **Freight** | Billed at cost, both ways |
| **Relocation between sites** | Free, 48-hour notice required |
| **Platform included** | Standard tier ($39/cam/mo equivalent) |
| **SOC monitoring** | Optional, $399/site/mo |

No setup fees. No activation fees. No "platform onboarding" fees. The lease number on your quote is what you pay every month for the trailer itself.

## What's included with every lease

- **Hardware** — trailer, mast, cameras, solar, batteries, cellular hardware
- **Platform access** — Standard tier subscription bundled with the lease price
- **Standard maintenance** — firmware updates, remote diagnostics, parts replacement
- **Cellular data** — dual-carrier LTE/5G, unlimited data on standard plans
- **Cloud storage** — 30-day video retention on AWS US-East/West
- **NDAA compliance documentation** — provided with every unit

## What's not included

- SOC active monitoring ($399/site/month, add or remove anytime after the first 30 days)
- Starlink uplink ($150/month, optional)
- On-site service calls beyond standard maintenance (T&M, only billed when a non-VDS cause requires truck roll)
- Customer-caused damage (covered by deposit + insurance)
- Platform upgrades to Pro or Enterprise

## Short-term and event rentals

For events, temporary jobsites, and incident-response deployments, we lease trailers under three months at a premium. Common use cases: festivals, sporting events, film sets, disaster recovery operations, temporary lay-down yards for major projects.

| Term | Pricing |
|---|---|
| **30 days** | 1.5x standard monthly rate |
| **60 days** | 1.25x standard monthly rate |
| **90+ days** | Standard rate |

Short-term rentals include the same hardware, platform, and freight handling as standard leases. SOC monitoring is highly recommended for events and is available on a per-night basis if a full month doesn't fit.

## Long-term and multi-year fleets

Multi-trailer, multi-year deployments get materially better economics. Common structures:

- **12-month commit:** 5% discount off standard lease rate
- **24-month commit:** 10% discount, includes one free trailer swap mid-term
- **36-month commit:** 15% discount, includes platform Pro tier upgrade
- **Fleet (5+ trailers):** volume matrix, negotiated MSA

Fleet customers also get a dedicated CSM, quarterly site review, and prioritized service scheduling.

## Lead time, in detail

Standard: **5-10 business days** from signed lease to on-site, including SOC onboarding and customer playbook configuration.

Expedited: **48-72 hours** for active incident response. We hold a small inventory of staged trailers in three regional depots (Mid-Atlantic, Southeast, West) for exactly this purpose. Expedited freight and overtime mobilization fees apply.

Multi-unit deployments of 3+ trailers may extend lead time depending on the trailer configuration. We'll quote the exact date with the quote.

## Early termination

If you cancel after the 3-month minimum, you owe nothing beyond the current month. Cancel mid-month and the remainder of that month is billed.

If you cancel during the minimum term, the remaining months of the minimum are payable. There is no separate ETF on top of that.

If you signed a multi-year commit, early termination is governed by your MSA — typically a glide-path payment that reflects unrecovered mobilization cost.

## Damage, loss, and insurance

Standard leases require the customer to maintain general liability and property coverage naming VDS as additional insured. We provide a sample certificate. Normal wear and tear is on us; customer-caused damage (vehicle strikes, vandalism beyond what the trailer self-deters, theft of the trailer itself) is on the customer.

faq.q: Can I really cancel month-to-month after 90 days?
faq.a: Yes. Give us 30 days' notice and pay the current month. No fees, no clawbacks.

faq.q: What if a trailer fails or underperforms?
faq.a: We swap it. Standard service-level expectation is a replacement on-site within 72 hours for a hardware failure that takes the unit offline. SOC monitors uptime continuously, so we usually know before you do.

faq.q: Do you lease used trailers at a discount?
faq.a: No. Every leased trailer is a current-revision, fully serviced unit. We retire trailers from the lease pool at end-of-service-life and sell them through a separate channel.

faq.q: Can I lease just the cameras, not the trailer?
faq.a: That's a platform-only deployment with customer-supplied cameras — see [Subscription Plans](/pricing/subscription-plans). Different product.
Yes, on Mobile Surveillance Unit. Standard lease-to-own runs 36 months at $2,200/mo with a $500 buyout at end of term. Other trailers quote-based.

finalCTABody: Quote in one business day. Trailer on site in 5-10 business days. Cancel any month after 90 days.

h1: Buy Outright When the Math Works
heroSubhead: For deployments that outlive a lease, ownership is the right answer. Mobile Surveillance Unit at $38,000, full warranty, and a service plan that doesn't disappear after the PO clears.
body:
## When purchase beats lease

Lease economics work best for deployments under 30 months. Above that, the math typically flips toward purchase. We've watched customers run the spreadsheet — here's the rule of thumb:

| Deployment horizon | Recommended model |
|---|---|
| <12 months | Lease, no question |
| 12-30 months | Lease, with optional buyout at end of term |
| 30+ months, single site | Purchase |
| Fleet, mobile across multiple sites | Lease (the flexibility outweighs the savings) |
| Capex-only budget cycles | Purchase, regardless of horizon |

The break-even on Mobile Surveillance Unit is roughly 18 months — $2,200 × 17.3 months = $38,000. After 18 months of ownership, every additional month is platform + maintenance only.

## What you pay for

The purchase price is hardware. Software and monitoring are sold separately as ongoing subscriptions, the same way they would be on a leased trailer. This keeps the capex number clean for finance teams and avoids bundling software cost into a depreciable asset.

| Item | Price | Type |
|---|---|---|
| **Mobile Surveillance Unit** | $38,000 | One-time, capex |
| **Mobile Surveillance Unit** | Contact | One-time, capex |
| **Mobile Surveillance Unit** | Contact | One-time, capex |
| **Solar-Powered Surveillance Kit** | Custom | One-time, capex |
| **VDS Platform (Standard)** | $39/cam/mo | Recurring, opex |
| **SOC Active Monitoring** | $399/site/mo | Recurring, opex |
| **Extended Warranty (3-year)** | 12% of purchase price | One-time, capex |
| **White-glove deployment** | $1,500/unit | One-time |

## Capex vs opex — how customers actually decide

The choice usually comes down to four factors:

**Budget structure.** Many enterprise security buyers have capex authority but limited opex. Trailers as a capex line are easier to approve than recurring lease payments. Government, education, and federal buyers in particular often prefer purchase for budget cycle reasons.

**Deployment longevity.** Single-site, permanent or near-permanent deployments — a port, a substation, a long-cycle data center build — favor purchase. Roving construction, event security, and disaster response favor lease.

**Refresh strategy.** Owning a trailer means owning the refresh decision. Cameras improve. Solar improves. Cellular standards shift (4G → 5G → whatever's next). Lease customers refresh implicitly when we update the lease pool. Purchase customers refresh when they decide to.

**Tax treatment.** Section 179 expensing and bonus depreciation may make purchase materially more attractive in a given tax year. We're not your CPA — talk to yours.

## Warranty terms

**Standard warranty (included, 12 months):**
- All trailer hardware against manufacturing defect
- Cameras, mast, solar panels, batteries, cellular hardware
- Excludes: customer-caused damage, acts of nature beyond design spec, neglect
- Parts shipped within 48 hours; labor billed at standard rate

**Extended warranty (optional, 3-year):**
- 12% of purchase price, paid up front
- Same coverage as standard, extended to 36 months total
- Adds 50% labor allowance on covered repairs
- Adds one free battery bank replacement at year 3

**Lifetime platform compatibility:**
We commit, in writing, that any trailer purchased from us will remain platform-compatible for a minimum of 7 years from delivery. Older trailers may not get every new feature, but they will not be EOL'd off the platform short of that horizon.

## Post-sale service

Ownership means you own the maintenance. We offer three service tiers for trailer owners:

| Plan | Price | What's covered |
|---|---|---|
| **Self-serve** | $0 | Remote firmware updates, platform support, parts at list |
| **Standard service** | $99/unit/mo | Above + 50% parts discount + 2 service calls/year included |
| **Premium service** | $249/unit/mo | Above + unlimited service calls + 4-hour response SLA + annual on-site PM |

Most purchase customers run Standard service. Premium is typical for fleet owners with mission-critical deployments where downtime cost exceeds the plan price.

## Trade-in

If you bought a trailer from us 4+ years ago and want to refresh, we offer trade-in credit toward a new unit. Typical trade-in value on a Mobile Surveillance Unit is 25-40% of original purchase price depending on age and condition. Quoted per unit on inspection.

faq.a: Yes. We work with two equipment financing partners for terms up to 60 months. Rates are credit-dependent. Most purchase customers, though, are using existing capex budget — financing tends to make the lease math more attractive than purchase math.

faq.q: What happens to platform features I bought when a new tier launches?
faq.a: New features land on existing platform tiers per the published roadmap. You don't lose anything by buying today. You may want to upgrade tier later if a Pro-tier feature becomes important.

faq.q: Can I sell a trailer I bought from VDS?
faq.a: Yes. It's your property. We'll re-onboard the new owner to the platform on standard terms. We don't charge a transfer fee, but the new owner becomes responsible for the platform subscription from the transfer date.

faq.q: What's the difference between Mobile Surveillance Unit purchase and lease-to-own?
faq.a: Purchase is one payment, ownership immediately. Lease-to-own is 36 monthly payments with a $500 buyout — total cost is higher, but the cash-flow profile fits some budgets better.

faq.q: Are purchase orders accepted, or do I need to prepay?
faq.a: Net-30 POs accepted for customers with approved credit. Standard for federal, state, and Fortune 1000 buyers. New customers may be asked for 50% deposit on the first unit.

finalCTABody: Quote, PO, build, ship. Typical purchase cycle is 4-6 weeks from PO. Service plan starts on delivery.

seoTitle: VDS Platform Subscription Plans | Standard, Pro, Enterprise
metaDescription: VDS platform pricing — Standard $39, Pro $69, Enterprise custom. Camera-agnostic VMS with 30/60/90-day retention. SOC add-on $399/site/mo.
h1: Platform Subscriptions, Per Camera, Per Month
heroSubhead: One pricing axis: how many cameras, which tier. Three tiers. No hidden seat fees, no analytics paywall on tier 1, no surprises on the invoice.
body:
## How platform pricing works

One dimension: per camera, per month, at the tier you pick. A 12-camera site on Pro is $69 × 12 = $828/month. A 40-camera campus on Standard is $39 × 40 = $1,560/month. There's no per-seat fee, no per-event fee, no analytics module to unlock at extra cost.

You can mix tiers across a fleet but not within a site — every camera at one physical site runs the same tier. This is a practical limit, not a billing trick; the analytics pipeline runs per-site for a reason.

## The three tiers

| | Standard | Pro | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Price** | $39/cam/mo | $69/cam/mo | Custom |
| **Cloud video retention** | 30 days | 60 days | 90 days (extendable) |
| **Live view (web + mobile)** | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| **Motion alerts** | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| **Basic analytics** | Person, vehicle | Person, vehicle | Person, vehicle |
| **Advanced analytics** | — | Intrusion, line-cross, loitering, PPE, crowding | All Pro + custom models |
| **LPR (per lane)** | — | $89/lane/mo add | Included up to fleet cap |
| **API access** | Read-only | Full read/write | Full + webhooks + SDK |
| **User seats** | 5 | 25 | Unlimited |
| **SSO (SAML/OIDC)** | — | — | Yes |
| **Audit logging** | Basic | Detailed | Forensic-grade |
| **Customer success** | Email + chat | Email + chat + scheduled calls | Dedicated CSM |
| **Onboarding** | Self-serve + docs | Standard onboarding call | White-glove |
| **Uptime SLA** | 99.5% | 99.9% | 99.95% |

## Which tier fits

**Standard ($39/cam/mo).** Single-site customers, general surveillance, no analytics requirements beyond person/vehicle motion. This is the right tier for the small construction site, the auto lot, the self-storage facility, the rural property. It's not stripped down — it's a complete VMS with 30-day retention and a real mobile app.

**Pro ($69/cam/mo).** The tier most multi-site customers settle on. Advanced analytics (line-crossing, loitering, PPE, crowd density) turn the platform from a recording system into a detection system. API access enables integration with dispatch, access control, and ticketing. Pro is the default tier on VDS trailer fleets running across 5+ sites.

**Enterprise (custom).** SSO, full audit logging, custom retention beyond 90 days, custom analytic models, and a dedicated CSM. Required for most federal contracts, regulated industries (utilities, healthcare, financial), and customers running 100+ cameras. Pricing is configuration-dependent — expect $50-$80/cam/mo equivalent in most configurations.

## SOC add-on

Every tier supports adding the VDS Security Operations Center for **$399/site/month**. SOC is priced per site, not per camera, so a 30-camera site costs the same to monitor as a 5-camera site.

What you get for $399:
- 24/7 live monitoring of priority alerts
- <60-second escalation on verified events
- Voice-down talk-down where hardware supports
- Direct dispatch coordination with your designated responders (police, internal security, on-call)
- Customer playbook configuration (what counts as priority, who gets called when)
- Weekly event summary report

The SOC is staffed in the US, trained on the VDS platform, and operating under ESA monitoring standards. Adding or removing SOC mid-subscription requires only a 30-day notice.

## Retention windows and why they matter

Retention isn't just a number — it's what determines whether you can answer the questions that come up two months after an incident.

- **30 days (Standard)** — fine for routine surveillance, investigations that surface within a month, and customers who plan to download evidence as soon as something happens
- **60 days (Pro)** — covers most insurance claim windows, employee dispute investigations, and the typical interval before a previously-unnoticed incident gets reported
- **90+ days (Enterprise)** — required for many regulated industries, federal contracts, and long-cycle dispute resolution

Customers can pull video to local archive at any time. Retention applies to cloud-resident video only.

## Billing, terms, and changes

- **Billing cycle:** monthly, invoiced on the 1st
- **Payment:** ACH preferred, credit card accepted up to $10K/month
- **Tier changes:** upgrade anytime (prorated), downgrade at next billing cycle
- **Add/remove cameras:** anytime, prorated
- **Cancellation:** 30-day notice, no early termination fees on month-to-mont
